body:
# ❄️ SpleefWars — Advanced Spleef Minigame System

**SpleefWars** is a fully automated Spleef minigame system for Fabric servers.
It includes group tournaments, arena reset, power-ups, elimination logic and a lobby system — perfect for minigame servers.

Players compete in multi-round Spleef matches where only the best 50% advance to the next round.

---

## ✨ Features

* Automatic lobby & group system
* Top 50% advancement after each round
* Snow breaks after standing for 3 seconds
* Snowballs destroy snow blocks
* Lava or falling below the arena = elimination
* Automatic arena reset after every round
* Power-ups (Speed / Invisibility / Snowballs)
* Spectator teleport system
* Multi-level arena support (3 layers by default)
* Admin commands for full arena control

---

## 🧱 Arena Setup (Admin)

Run these commands **once** to configure the arena:

```
/spleef area pos1
/spleef area pos2
```

```
/spleef spawn set 1
/spleef spawn set 2
/spleef spawn set 3
/spleef spawn set 4
```

```
/spleef spectator set
```

Optional power-ups:

```
/spleef itemspawn add SNOWBALL
/spleef itemspawn add SPEED
/spleef itemspawn add INVIS
```

---

## 🎮 Playing a Match

Players join:

```
/spleef join
```

Admin controls:

```
/spleef groups
/spleef start <group>
```

After each round:

* The arena resets automatically
* The top 50% advance
* New groups are generated

---

## 🛠 Commands

### Player Commands

```
/spleef join
/spleef leave
```

### Admin Commands

```
/spleef area pos1
/spleef area pos2
/spleef spawn set <1-4>
/spleef spectator set
/spleef groups
/spleef start <group>
/spleef reset
/spleef stop
```

### Power-up Commands

```
/spleef itemspawn add <SNOWBALL|SPEED|INVIS>
/spleef itemspawn list
/spleef itemspawn remove <id>
```

---

## ⚔️ Game Rules

* Snowballs break snow blocks
* Standing on snow for 3 seconds destroys it
* Touching lava eliminates a player
* Falling below the arena eliminates a player
* Eliminated players become spectators
* Only the best 50% advance

---

## 📦 Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API required
* Server-side mod

---

Built for competitive Spleef tournaments and minigame servers.
Enjoy fast-paced arena battles!
